import hmplot as hm

    "width": [3.0, 3.5, 2.7, 3.0, 3.1],
    "species": ["A", "A", "B", "B", "B"],
}

with hm.Plot(data=flowers, height=400, axes2d=True, legend=True) as plot:
    hm.Points(x="length", y="width", fill="species", size=4, label="Observations")
